# Growing Guns mod API

Every `*.luau` file under `mods/` is a module. It hot-reloads when saved: a load error keeps the previous version, a runtime error turns that module's hooks off until the file changes. Modules run on the host inside the 60 Hz sim tick, in path order; the same mods and seed replay exactly.

Sandbox: no `os`, `io`, `require`, `loadstring` or `math.random` (use `g:random()`). Each call gets a step budget (calls and loop iterations), the VM 64 MB. `state` is a per-module table that survives reloads. `print` goes to the game log. Do not depend on `pairs` order over tables keyed by tables or functions.

## Module exports

A module returns a table of this type (every key optional):

```luau
type Exports = {
	cards: { Card }?,
	hit: ((g: Game, e: Hit) -> number?)?,
	kill: ((g: Game, e: Kill) -> ())?,
	tick: ((g: Game) -> ())?,
	round_start: ((g: Game) -> ())?,
}
```

- `hit`: Before damage lands. Return the damage to deal (nil keeps it). Modules chain.
- `kill`: A player died.
- `tick`: End of every sim tick (60 per second). Keep it cheap.
- `round_start`: A new round's arena and spawns are ready.

```luau
type Hit = { victim: number, attacker: number, damage: number, head: boolean, explosion: boolean }
type Kill = { victim: number, attacker: number? }  -- attacker nil: lava
```

## Cards

```luau
type Card = {
  id: string,             -- stable; what `give P ID` uses
  name: string?, text: string?,
  color: { number }?,     -- sRGB {r, g, b}, 0..1
  firepower: boolean?,    -- improves the gun (every offer has one)
  mul: { [string]: number }?,  -- stat multipliers, applied first
  add: { [string]: number }?,  -- stat additions, applied second
  pick: ((g: Game, p: number) -> ())?,  -- runs once when taken
}
```

Stats:

- `damage`: bullet damage multiplier
- `fire_rate`: shots per second multiplier
- `spread`: spread cone multiplier (lower is tighter)
- `recoil`: recoil multiplier
- `speed`: move speed multiplier
- `bullet_speed`: bullet speed multiplier
- `reload`: reload speed multiplier
- `mag_bonus`: extra rounds per magazine
- `hp_bonus`: extra max health
- `explosive_radius`: bullet blast radius in metres (0: no blast)
- `explosive_damage`: blast damage at the centre

## `g`: the match

Players are numbers 1..`g:players()`. `g` is only valid during the call that received it.

- `g:players(): number`: Number of players.
- `g:alive(p: number): boolean`: Player p is alive.
- `g:bot(p: number): boolean`: Player p is a bot.
- `g:pos(p: number): vector`: Position (capsule centre), metres.
- `g:set_pos(p: number, v: vector)`: Teleport.
- `g:vel(p: number): vector`: Velocity, m/s.
- `g:set_vel(p: number, v: vector)`: Set velocity (knockback, launch pads).
- `g:aim(p: number): vector`: Unit vector the player looks along.
- `g:health(p: number): number`: Health (0 when dead).
- `g:set_health(p: number, hp: number)`: Set health, capped at max health. Does not kill: use damage.
- `g:max_health(p: number): number`: 100 plus the hp_bonus stat.
- `g:damage(p: number, amount: number, by: number?): boolean`: Damage at the start of the next tick, credited to player `by`; can kill, skips the hit hooks. False over quota.
- `g:ammo(p: number): number`: Rounds in the magazine.
- `g:set_ammo(p: number, n: number)`: Set rounds in the magazine.
- `g:score(p: number): number`: Rounds won.
- `g:stat(p: number, name: string): number`: A card stat (see stats()).
- `g:set_stat(p: number, name: string, value: number)`: Change a card stat.
- `g:stats(): {string}`: Names of the card stats.
- `g:cards(p: number): {string}`: Ids of the cards player p holds, in pick order.
- `g:card_ids(): {string}`: Ids of every card on offer this match.
- `g:give(p: number, id: string): boolean`: Give a card at the start of the next tick (stats and pick hook). False over quota.
- `g:explode(at: vector, radius: number, damage: number, by: number?): boolean`: Explosion at the start of the next tick. False over quota (32 per tick).
- `g:tick(): number`: Sim ticks since the match started (60 per second).
- `g:time(): number`: Match time in seconds.
- `g:round(): number`: Round number, from 1.
- `g:between_rounds(): boolean`: The round is over (intermission and card picks).
- `g:random(): number`: Uniform in [0, 1), from the match seed: the same every replay.
